introduction.summary: This specification records the project purpose, stakeholder constraints and unresolved decisions stated in the source evidence below.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-001
items.detail: Design a secure network configuration management system for a university that manages configuration changes across routers, switches, wireless controllers, and other network infrastructure.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-002
items.detail: Authorized network administrators should be able to review current configurations, submit configuration changes, track change history, and restore previously approved configurations when necessary.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-003
items.detail: The system should detect unauthorized or unexpected configuration changes, generate security alerts, maintain audit logs of configuration activity and administrator actions, and restrict administrative functions based on approved roles.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-004
items.detail: The platform should provide a centralized dashboard, integrate with existing university identity services, support multiple campus locations, and remain secure, reliable, scalable, and manageable.

open_issues: What makes a configuration change unauthorized?
Which fields must the audit logs contain?
